emu.z_rule: z = R1's 6th-7th biased gap / sigma_l at each (token, layer) pair where the natural selection's top-6 set differs from R1's; sigma_l = RMS over the T1-T8 rows and all experts of (router logits - R1 router logits) in layer l, float64 (DESIGN §3.5); sigma_t = the same RMS over the experts of one token; with sigma_l = 0 a pair's z is +inf if its gap > 0, else 0

bpb.rule: NLL(ids[t+1] | ids[:t+1]) summed over t = 0..T-2, / ln 2, / UTF-8 bytes of tokens 1..T-1; mean pooled over T1-T6
